newsitem.title: CHINA: Gold Peak loan increased to US$60 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gold Peak loan increased to US$60 mln.

text.p: Gold Peak Industries (Holdings) Ltd's revolving credit/term loan facility has been increased to US$60 million from US$40 million, lead arranger Commerz East Asia said.
The facility was 2.5 times subscribed and scaled back to US$60 million, the lead arranger said.
The four-year facility pays a margin of 65 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. There is a commitment fee of 25 basis points.
Fees are 62 basis points for co-lead managers and 55 basis points for managers.
Proceeds will be used for general working capital.
Commerz East Asia is the lead arranger and bookrunner.
Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Citicorp International, Credit Agricole Indosuez and Fuji Bank are the arrangers.
Fifteen financial institutions in addition to the lead arranger and arrangers group joined the syndication.
